name: Neon Range
summary: A neon shooting gallery: aim with the mouse, chain combos and dodge the red spikes
about: A full-page arcade shooter on a scrolling synth grid. Neon rings, diamonds, splitting hexagons and gold time-stars glide across the screen; you aim with the mouse and fire a laser from the turret, with sparks, shockwaves, score pops, combo banners and screen shake on every hit. Good as a fun extra on a portfolio, a game corner or a party page.
how: Press Start: you have 60 seconds and 3 lives. Your mouse is the crosshair; click to fire (tap on touch screens).
Every hit scores points; five hits in a row raise the combo multiplier up to x5, and a miss resets it.
Splitters break into three shards, gold stars add 5 seconds, and hitting a red spike costs a life with a big shake.
Keyboard: arrow keys or WASD aim, Space fires, P or Escape pauses; the game also pauses when you switch tabs.
At the end you see score, accuracy, hits and best combo, and your best score is kept; with reduced motion there is no shake or flash and fewer particles.
